The core insight is that environmental and human factors interact dynamically to shape game outcomes. Air density modifies ball physics, which impacts deep-ball and kick distance expectations. Injury statuses alter unit depth and pressure dynamics, shifting scheme leverage. Tracking data provides real-time efficiency corrections to player projections. These elements are aggregated via Bayesian inference in GSI, where Kalshi priors are updated with environmental and injury modifiers. GSE uses these refined states to model situational transitions, such as defensive pressure shifts or prop value changes.
